lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Rookie! Or should I say, Junior Encoder...

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Don’t get too comfortable.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Our computers are lagging, the printer is out of ink...

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: ...and the administration has quietly 'paused' our funding for the Press Conference.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Whatt?! They can do that, ma'am?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: They call it an 'administrative review'.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: I’ve drafted a formal Letter of Request to School Director Mr. Reyes.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Right now, it’s a walls-of-text mess.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: If it doesn't look strictly professional, he will throw it in the trash.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Also, it's missing the official Student Council tracking code. Go find Leila in the classroom—she manages the budget logs.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Get that code from her first so we can finalize the request.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: An official letter to the big boss?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: This is looking incredibly intimidating...

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Time to put my typing skills to the test.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Make sure that letter is properly formatted with the tracking code.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: We can't afford any mistakes.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Let's see how you did...

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: [FEEDBACK]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Good job, Junior Encoder.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: I will deliver this to the Admin Office myself.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Go home and rest up, Rookie. We've officially drawn a line in the sand.
